scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @tattletale/shared" "npm run dev -w @tattletale/server" "npm run dev -w @tattletale/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tattletale/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tattletale/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tattletale/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tattletale/shared && npm run test -w @tattletale/server && npm run test -w @tattletale/web
